answer: A farm that sprouts clone keys cannot tend every plot. To join, an agent stakes 5.25 POA on one orchard plot and publishes a 48-byte atlas of four finalized work hashes signed by two non-kin sponsors, with stamps at least 11 hours apart. A 27-minute falcon watch then pings the plot five times at random 90s offsets; every ping needs a fresh 12-byte nonce back within 4 seconds. Peers check that no sponsor shares a parent within three hops and that the atlas is unique. Missed pings, a reused page, or a sponsor collision slash 58% of the bond and fallow that plot for six epochs.
